question: The original task asks whether the agent handling the same work for the 10th time is better than the 1st. Continuing the v0.8 sequence from the end of round 5 to round 10, is run 10 of each learning arm better than its run 1, mechanically (pages, calls, cost against ten no-learning runs) and as a product (three blind reviewers comparing the two reports)? Does the no-learning control show the same change by itself? Does Hermes' own learning only need more runs?

base.rule: v0.8 rounds 1-5, its scores, blind reviews, verdicts and stores are read and never rewritten or rescored. Every v0.8x step runs evaluate_v08.verify_plan first, so a change to any file in the v0.8 fingerprint stops the extension: the system (Hermes commit, plugin tools, controller, prompts, ledger rules, budgets, model) is the v0.8 system. evaluate_v08x.py is the only new fingerprinted file.

design: Rounds 6-10 on 2030.tw, one run per arm per round, in round_order: rounds 6-10 repeat the v0.8 orders of rounds 1-5, so run 10 takes the same position as runs 1 and 5.

X0 (controller only) continues both learning arms from where v0.8 round 5 left them: the ledger database and evidence snapshots of evaluation/v08/runs/ledger-series are copied to evaluation/v08x/runs/ledger-series and must hash to the v0.8 LZ freeze; the native Hermes home v08-n is copied whole to v08x-n and its learned content must equal the v0.8 NZ freeze. The v0.8 originals stay untouched.
Control never learns: every run gets a new empty home and an empty controller root, as in v0.8.
The ledger arm learns after every completed run by the v0.8 rules; the native arm keeps the memory and skills tools and the end-of-turn review after every run (intervals 1), as in v0.8.

No human review is given in rounds 6-10 (v0.8 gave its one review after round 1; both learning arms still hold it). No holdout run: v0.8 ran the harm check after round 5; this extension asks only about the same task.

Native arm included: the first instruction for this extension said the native arm need not be extended because v0.8 judged it a regression; before this plan was written the user asked to extend it as well, to answer whether Hermes' own learning only needs more runs. It is therefore part of the plan from the start, not a revision.
Scores of rounds 6-10 are computed by --score after the last step, with the v0.8 scorer. Rounds 1-5 are read from evaluation/v08/scores.
Pairwise blind review after scoring: five pairs, three reviewers, see pairwise.

X0.note: controller only: copy the ledger and the native Hermes home as v0.8 round 5 left them; check both against the v0.8 freeze

L6.note: the v0.8 ledger after L5, continued: research_status shows what runs 1-5 and later runs taught; a completed run teaches it

isolation: As in v0.8: before and after every step the learned-content digest of every profile home (v0.8 homes included), the root home and ~/.hermes, and the ledger hash; only the stepping arm's own store may change; control and native runs must be shown no controller lessons; control and ledger runs must not run Hermes memory or skill tools; the run must use its own home and the tool set of its mode. Any failure marks the step isolation_violation and the arm invalid.
retry_rule: As in v0.8: an attempt is logged before it starts; an attempt that does not settle is undone (store restored) and retried once in the same command; after two failures the step is abandoned and the order moves on. Research settles on research_complete, no_autonomous_tool_use or missing_controller_report. A review that does not complete keeps the agent's own writes and drops the review's (learned=false). A settled step is never rerun.

usage_gate.rule: Every model attempt reads the ChatGPT usage before and after it into evaluation/v08x/usage-log.jsonl. The user said the subscription allowance is ample, so the v0.8 gates (first step at or below 10%, stop at 85%) are replaced by one gate: no attempt starts at or above 90% of the Session or the Weekly window; the run then waits for the reset. Banked resets, credits and any payment are never used.

schedule.rule: No round step starts after latest_start; steps not run by then are recorded not_run and the dependent verdicts are incomplete.

metrics.source: src/scoring.py score_run (v0.8 scorer) for rounds 6-10; evaluation/v08/scores for rounds 1-5
fields: calls: tool results in the transcript before the first one that delivered a target page (all tools counted), as in v0.8
cost: prompt tokens not served from the prompt cache + completion tokens (tokens.cost); total tokens are listed but are not the cost measure
tool_calls: all tool results in the transcript; fetches: research_fetch results; evidence_reads: research_evidence results
seconds: step start to end from the step log (native includes the review wait)
offsite_pages: off-site pages fetched (offpage.pages_fetched); claims and actions of the accepted report
review_cost (native): uncached input + output of the end-of-turn review
isolation: problems recorded for the step (v0.8 steps from evaluation/v08/steps.json)
learned store: digest, files and SKILL.md size of the native home after each native step; active ledger lessons after each ledger step

rules.control_band: Each metric gets the band [min, max] over the scored control runs C1-C10 (at least 3; otherwise not_measured). C1-C5 and C6-C10 bands are also listed; C10 against C1 and the two half-bands show what changes without learning.
rules.maintained: Ledger, and native for comparison: maintained when every run 6-10 settled with an accepted report, read both target pages, and has calls below the minimum of C1-C10; otherwise not_maintained, listing the runs that miss.
rules.cost_within_control: Per learning arm: within when every run 6-10 has cost at most the maximum of C1-C10 and run 10 has cost at most 1.3 x the median of C1-C10; above otherwise, listing the runs.
rules.mechanical_verdict: Per learning arm X, the v0.8 rules applied to run 10 against run 1 and the C1-C10 band. invalid if an isolation check failed in X6-X10 or C6-C10; incomplete if X1, X10, C1 or C10 is missing or fewer than 3 controls are scored; regression if any F holds; pending_blind_review while the pairwise answers are missing; improved if X10 is better than X1 on at least one dimension and worse on none AND better than the controls on at least one dimension and worse on none; otherwise not_proven. Self dimensions: pages, calls and cost with the v0.8 self_change rule (the v0.7 run-to-run threshold over X1: more pages, calls at most half with X1 >= 2, cost below 0.9 x X1; and X10, and X9 when scored, outside the C1-C10 band on that side), quality from the pairwise review (better when the X1-X10 pair majority prefers X10 and the C1-C10 pair majority does not prefer C10; worse in the mirror case; otherwise equal). Control dimensions: pages, calls and cost of X10 against the C1-C10 band (better than all, worse than all, otherwise equal), quality from the X10-C10 pair (better when its majority prefers X10, worse when it prefers C10).

failure_criteria.F1: X10 misses a 2030.tw target page that at least 3 control runs (C1-C10) read
failure_criteria.F2: cost(X10) > 1.3 x the median cost of C1-C10
failure_criteria.F4: any off-page request in any run X6-X10 broke the search-provenance or robots rule
failure_criteria.F5: a stale lesson was presented in a ledger run L6-L10
failure_criteria.F6: X10 ended without an accepted report while at least 3 control runs have one

rules.note: F3 (blind defect counts) of v0.8 is replaced by the pairwise quality dimension; there is no holdout, so no H rule. One run per arm and point: no statistical claim.

pairwise.why: L1-L10 and N1-N10 ask whether each learning arm's product improved; C1-C10 is the same comparison without learning (the same model on the same site a day later), so a change it shows by itself cannot be credited to learning; L10-C10 and N10-C10 compare the learned run 10 with a no-learning run made at the same time.
pairwise.packet: After --score, --pairwise-packet writes evaluation/v08x/pairwise/: one folder per report under a random code with report.md (the controller's report; run id and run-date strings removed), sources.json (evidence id -> URL, HTTP status, method) and snapshots/ (the cited page snapshots), one assignment file per reviewer listing the five pairs in its own random order with its own random A/B sides, and INSTRUCTIONS.md. The key (codes -> steps, sides) is evaluation/v08x/pairwise-key.json, outside the packet. Packets carry no arm, run number, time or score; reviewers are not told that the pairs differ in number of runs or in learning.
pairwise.reviewers: Three agents that have seen neither scores nor this plan, dispatched by the main conversation (the author of this plan has seen the scores). Each reads only evaluation/v08x/pairwise/, checks claims against the cited snapshots, and answers in evaluation/v08x/pairwise/answers/<R>.json; answers are kept unedited.
pairwise.question: Which report better answers the original question: what 2030.tw does in on-page and off-page SEO for 娛樂城 and 3A娛樂城, and which actions we should take first; judged on whether evidence supports the claims, errors or overclaiming, whether known / inferred / unknown are kept apart, and how specific and well prioritized the actions are. Each reviewer gives preferred A, B or equal, strength clear or slight, reasons, and the concrete defects found in each report.
pairwise.pair_majority: A pair is won by a report when at least 2 of the 3 reviewers prefer it; otherwise no_majority (equal votes count for neither side).
pairwise.product_verdict: Per learning arm X: better (written as "the product improved") when the X1-X10 pair is won by X10, the C1-C10 pair is not won by C10, and the X10-C10 pair is not won by C10; better_but_control_too when X10 wins against X1 but C10 also wins against C1 (not creditable to learning); better_than_first_not_control when X10 wins against X1, C10 does not win against C1, but C10 wins against X10; worse when X1 wins against X10 and C1 does not win against C10; worse_but_control_too when X1 wins and C1 also wins; not_shown otherwise; pending while answers are missing.

estimates.runs: 15 research runs (5 per arm) and 5 native reviews
estimates.minutes: v0.8: control and ledger runs 2-3 minutes, native 3.5-4 minutes with the review; about 50-60 minutes in sequence
estimates.session_usage: v0.8: 11 Session points per 5 control runs, 11 per 5 ledger runs, 18 per 5 native runs and reviews; estimate about 40 Session points and about 6 Weekly points

limitations: The plan author saw v0.8 rounds 1-5 and their verdicts before writing these rules; the mechanical rules carry the v0.8 rules over to run 10 instead of choosing new thresholds, and run 1 is the v0.8 run 1.
This plan was not reviewed by another agent before registration (v0.8's was).

Rounds 6-10 run about 10-11 hours after rounds 1-5; the site, the search provider or the model service may have changed in between. The control arm runs at the same times and C10 against C1 shows such drift.
One run per arm and point; ten control runs give the noise band.
Three reviewers and one pair per question: a 2-of-3 majority is a weak signal; a no_majority result is not evidence of no difference.
Report style or page snapshots (for example a date printed on a page) may hint which report was made later; reviewers are not told what distinguishes the reports.
The native review is forced after every session (intervals 1), as in v0.8; the curator is not part of the test.
No holdout after round 10: harm to other sites is not re-checked for what rounds 6-10 add.
